key.name: voices
key.description: The voice chosen for each language (language code such as "de" to voice id). A language without an entry speaks with its default voice. Speech is always in the system language.

key.name: rate
key.description: How fast every speech output of the system speaks; 1.0 is the voice's normal rate.

key.name: announce-callers
key.description: While a call rings and a Bluetooth headset or headphones are connected, say who is calling (the name from the contacts, else "Unknown caller"). Not in the car.

key.name: keep-voice
key.description: Seconds after the last speech output before the voice is freed again.
